##### Project general facts

Oxford Terraces 2 is a contemporary residential development designed to reflect modern Dubai living through spacious layouts, refined finishes, and a strong sense of architectural sophistication. The design features high ceilings and expansive windows that frame panoramic city views, enhancing natural light and openness throughout each residence. With its clean lines and thoughtfully planned structure, the building offers a selection of lifestyle-oriented apartments that combine elegance with everyday functionality.

The development offers a well-curated range of lifestyle amenities designed to balance relaxation, wellness, and family living. Residents can enjoy a striking double-height lobby that sets a luxurious tone, along with cabanas and viewing decks that overlook scenic surroundings. A rooftop adults’ swimming pool, lush landscaped gardens, and a fully equipped gym with modern fitness equipment provide spaces for relaxation and activity, while a rooftop BBQ area encourages social gatherings and memorable evenings. Additional facilities such as a children’s play area ensure a complete community-focused environment.

Inside, Oxford Terraces 2 features interiors that combine contemporary and classic influences, creating a refined and welcoming atmosphere. Bedrooms are designed with carefully selected furnishings and décor elements that enhance comfort and luxury, while bathrooms feature textured walls and elegant marble finishes that add a sense of sophistication. Kitchens are fitted with Teka appliances, blending functionality with a minimalist aesthetic. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their homes while enjoying a high-quality foundation of modern design and finishes.

##### Location description and benefits

Real estate in Jumeirah Village Circle is one of the most sought-after housing options. It is popular among both potential tenants and investors. About 2,000 housing units are available in the complex, which includes huge villas, townhouses, studio flats, and multi-bedroom apartments in high-rise buildings. There are still plenty of under-construction facilities. JVC is home to cutting-edge mid-rise buildings and renowned hotels. The Nakheel company, the project’s developer, aimed to create a space that was pleasant for living as well as resting and unwinding. There are three nurseries, a university, a school, a hospital, and a shopping mall. There are numerous green zones and parks with playgrounds in the area. Because of this, renting out a residence in JVC is a fantastic idea. Rental income brings in 6.8%, one of the highest rates in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates.

There will undoubtedly be a park close by, regardless of the residence or apartment you reside in. After all, 33 parks are spread out in a small housing complex with an area of 8 km². Some of them are rather small and are only suitable for a playground or benches under trees. However, some of them like Circle Community Park or JVC Community Park, can be referred to as completely green parks.

There are green spaces here for people of all ages. The housing development features dog parks and playgrounds. Since there is also a pet-friendly cafe where pets are welcome, the location is perfect for pet owners overall.
